parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the service is deployed.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The keyword used to query instances. Instances can be queried based on instance name, instance IP address, IP address of the server where the instance resides, and instance type.

parameters.name: HostIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the server where the instance resides.

parameters.name: InstanceIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the instance.

parameters.name: IsSpot
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance is a preemptible instance.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order.

Valid values:

*   asc

    <!-- -->

*   desc

    <!-- -->

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.
